note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground on the west shore of South Manistique Lake, 5.5 mi SW of Curtis via South Curtis Road, Long Pointe Road, Sherman Road and Randall Road. Some sites have direct water access by a narrow footpath; carry-in access for canoes and kayaks at the boat launch on the south side (shallow/sandy). Walleye, crappie and bluegill. Trail 8 is reachable from the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 30 sites for tent, small and large trailer with pull-through site 27 (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Part of the page's Fishing/Paddling text is copied from Gemini Lake (DNR page error). No road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements.
